nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify's matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language match; a wording mismatch between the user's question and the graph's labels collapses the answer to noise unless the query is first expanded against the graph's own extracted vocabulary (never inventing tokens).

nodes.label: BFS/DFS Traversal Modes
nodes.rationale: BFS (default) for broad nearest-neighbor context; DFS (--dfs) for tracing a specific chain/dependency path, depth-limited to 6.

nodes.label: Work Memory Self-Improving Loop
nodes.rationale: save-result --outcome useful|dead_end|corrected feeds graphify reflect, which regenerates LESSONS.md (preferred sources, dead ends, corrections) so future sessions don't re-derive the same dead ends.

nodes.label: /graphify path and /graphify explain
nodes.rationale: path finds shortest route between two named concepts; explain gives a plain-language summary of one node's connections, both backed by the same graph.json.
